mapper.select: select count(*) from talent_major
select count(*) from subject where del_flag = '0' and status = '0'
select count(*) from knowledge_point where del_flag = '0' and status = '0'
select count(*) from subject where del_flag = '0' and status = '0' and code in ('sub_algorithm', 'sub_os', 'sub_network', 'sub_computer_org')

select s.id as subjectId, s.name as courseName, s.code as courseCode, s.description as description, s.sort_order as sortOrder, (select count(*) from knowledge_point p where p.subject_id = s.id and p.del_flag = '0' and p.status = '0') as pointCount from subject s where s.del_flag = '0' and s.status = '0' order by s.sort_order, s.id

select p.subject_id as subjectId, p.name as pointName, p.difficulty as difficulty, p.importance as importance from knowledge_point p join subject s on s.id = p.subject_id where p.del_flag = '0' and p.status = '0' and s.del_flag = '0' and s.status = '0' order by p.subject_id, p.sort_order, p.id
select date_format(max(create_time), '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') from talent_job_posting

select p.batch_date as batchDate, count(*) as jobCount, count(distinct p.job_family) as familyCount, (select count(distinct s.skill_name) from talent_job_skill s where s.batch_date = p.batch_date) as skillCount, date_format(min(p.create_time), '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') as firstTime, date_format(max(p.create_time), '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') as lastTime from talent_job_posting p group by p.batch_date order by p.batch_date
select m.id as majorId, m.major_code as majorCode, m.major_name as majorName, m.job_family as jobFamily, m.graduate as graduate, m.remark as remark from talent_major m order by m.id
mapper.delete: delete from talent_job_posting where source = #{source} and batch_date = #{batchDate}
mapper.insert: insert into talent_job_posting (batch_date, keyword, city, job_title, description, source, skill_names, create_time, job_family, industry) values (#{batchDate}, #{keyword}, #{city}, #{jobTitle}, #{description}, #{source}, #{skillNames}, #{createTime}, #{jobFamily}, #{industry})
insert into talent_job_skill (posting_id, batch_date, skill_name, skill_category) values (#{postingId}, #{batchDate}, #{skillName}, #{skillCategory})
mapper.select: select skill_name as skillName, category from talent_skill_category
